bargeIn._note: B-07 OFF by default: on the Galaxy A20e (2026-09-28) the echo canceller let the phone's own TTS through, so every long reply interrupted itself. Turn on per device after checking; SelfEcho still guards against it.

reading._note: A screen reading is spoken in parts of about partSeconds at the user's speech rate (was a fixed 480 characters, ~30 s), each ending 'There's more — say continue'; the mic re-opens after each part for 'continue' or 'stop'.

en: Let me check that for you.
Alright, let me take a look.
Let me find that for you.
fillers._note: Spoken in the reply voice (the phone's engine). Twi is empty on purpose: the old Twi phrasings were never verified by a native speaker and the English engine reads Twi badly, so a Twi session plays the progress tone. Add verified phrases here.
